title: Item Generator
description:
Lets you generate customized items in-game.
Does not work in newer Snapshots!
body:
Disclaimer: Needs to be used in snapshot 25w20a!
The /dialog command just has been added to the game.

This Datapack lets you generate any custom item using the standart carrot on a stick. You can input:
Item Type, Item Model, Item Name, Count and if it has enchantment glint.
Warning: This can be used by any player in any gamemode in the world. Make sure to adjust the tick function to your liking. Its only 4 commands in this datapack.
